name: Arcing Hand Crossbow
text:
This +1 hand crossbow is imbued with an enchantment that provides a momentary burst of enhanced accuracy against those with some protection.

Activate—Curve Bolt 2

Frequency once per day

Requirements You fire a bolt from the crossbow that curves slightly in flight. Make a ranged Strike with a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This attack ignores the target's cover.
